candidates.excerpt: In June this year more than a dozen children were killed in a roof collapse at a tutoring centre in the eastern city of Lahore.

candidates.title: Imran Khan asked to leave India: What rights do OCI cardholders have?
candidates.excerpt: Actor Imran Khan faces deportation from India by October 28 due to his involvement in a protest. This action stems from a complaint lodged by BJP leader Kirit Somaiya regarding legal violations during the demonstration. Khan, a US citizen and OCI cardholder, was detained at the protest site in Mumbai. His participation raises questions about the rights of foreign nationals involved in political activities.

candidates.title: Right to protest vs public order in India: When can police restrict peaceful demonstrations? What the law says
candidates.excerpt: Protest is a fundamental right in democracy, enabling citizens to register dissent, demand accountability and effect change in public policy. Where a valid law requires prior permission, the state may enforce that requirement even against a peaceful gathering, experts said.

candidates.title: SC upholds Madras HC order striking down TN reservation benefit for Muslim converts
candidates.excerpt: The Supreme Court on Thursday upheld a Madras High Court judgment declaring unconstitutional a Tamil Nadu government order allowing people from Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes, Denotified Communities and Scheduled Castes to claim Backward Class (Muslim) reservation benefits after converting to Islam.

candidates.excerpt: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and City Council Speaker Julie Menin have backed legislation to phase out horse-drawn carriages by June 2028 following the death of 18-year-old Indian tourist Romanch Mahajan in a Central Park accident.
